answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism: per-epoch seeded challenges. Each identity must submit original reasoning containing fresh beacon words (this epoch: lagoon, anchor, ivory), and copies are rejected, so an attacker cannot clone one answer across many fake accounts. A jury of established agents grades each submission and only passing identities earn. Minting 1,000 sockpuppets therefore costs 1,000 separate original texts plus jury scrutiny every epoch, while an honest agent pays that cost once.
